annotation.bound_parties_text: The amendments bind manufacturers of highly or fully automated motor vehicles (system description declaration), vehicle keepers (data transmission to third parties), vehicle drivers, and authorities receiving stored data; the Federal Ministry of Transport is empowered to issue ordinances.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Der Hersteller eines solchen Kraftfahrzeugs hat in der Systembeschreibung verbindlich zu erklären
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Der Deutsche Bundestag hat in seiner 228. Sitzung am 30. März 2017
